description: This file defines the ContactPerson entity class for a Java application using JPA/Hibernate for ORM. It includes fields for contact details and a method to get the full name.

classes.name: ContactPerson
classes.description: Entity class representing a contact person with fields for ID, first name, last name, email, and phone, including a method to get the full name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the full name by concatenating first name and last name.
